question: \(f(x)=x^2\) and \(y=f(2x)\). What is the derivative of \(y\) at \(x=1\)?
solution: \((x^2)'\) evaluated at \(2x\) is \(2\times(2x)\), then multiply by \(2\). At \(x=1\), the result is \(8\).
